descriptions.w3d_d20e_reset_timer_widget_80223a78: Resets the LumpFileId, HighlightedMessage, SelectedMessage and ChangedRenderState string properties (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string 0x804b06a0 through a temporary copy, registers the BorderColour binding (0x801ece2c), sets the TimerPosition vector binding (0x801f0210) to (0, 0, 0) and TimerScale to (20, 20, 0) from the constants 0x803b76c8/0x803b76cc, calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
